scope: 在保持 ready/valid、held response、MMU/data overlap、fetch-fault merge、精确提交和 kill/reissue 语义的前提下，隔离 memwb_fetch_wait/stall_wb/exmem_can_accept 对 FP wrapper TX_DONE D 的残余控制锥，并补充 T016 focused 检查。

timing_source.why_boolean_rewrite_is_unsafe: memwb_fetch_wait may coincide with an occupied older EX/MEM entry; consuming the FP response would clear ID/EX while EX/MEM remains held and lose the response

implementation.summary: Add a one-entry wrapper-to-core response hold with direct bypass. The wrapper rsp_ready is fp_exec_rsp_ready = A64_FP_SIMD && !fp_rsp_hold_valid; core fp_rsp_ready/fp_consume retains the exact EX/MEM acceptance predicate. A blocked raw response is captured once, fp_tx_issued remains set until core consumption, and kill/reset clears ownership and hold before any architectural effect.

boundary.direct_bypass: When fp_rsp_hold_valid=0 and core fp_rsp_ready=1, raw fp_exec_rsp is consumed directly and no hold register is written.
boundary.blocked_capture: When raw fp_exec_rsp is valid/accepted but core fp_rsp_ready=0, fp_rsp_hold captures the complete packed response and holds valid until fp_consume.
boundary.owner: fp_tx_issued clears on core fp_consume rather than raw wrapper handshake, preventing duplicate request issue while a held response is pending.
boundary.kill: lcvex_fp_exec kill priority and core hold kill priority discard a same-edge raw response atomically; core kill boundaries remain unchanged.
boundary.payload: fp_rsp muxes hold over raw; all FP result/flags/NZCV/GPR forwarding uses the core-facing stable response.
boundary.architectural_latency: Direct response-to-EX/MEM latency is unchanged; a response that was previously held in TX_DONE reaches EX/MEM on the same later acceptance edge, with only the non-architectural storage location changed.

sva: raw wrapper response with empty hold implies fp_exec_rsp_ready
raw response blocked at core boundary enters fp_rsp_hold on the next cycle unless kill
held response remains held while core-side ready is low
held response clears exactly after core-side ready/consume
hold and wrapper raw response never overlap
core-facing response payload remains stable while valid and not ready unless killed
